page.layout: One title page, all lines centred: title block at top, then "Quam" and the presiding professor's name, a line of purpose, the four candidates' names, the date line, and the printer's imprint at the foot.
page.notes: The handwritten "32." in the top right corner is manuscript, not printed, so it is left out. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The day in "Die Febr." has no printed numeral; the gap is kept as shown. "&" is the printed ampersand (in the image it is the ornamental "&" form). The line under the date is a printed rule and is not transcribed as text.
